usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove an ACME plugin configuration from the cluster. Before deleting, ensure no ACME accounts or domains are referencing this plugin; removing a plugin that is still in use will prevent certificate renewals from succeeding. Requires the Sys.Modify privilege at the root path — only cluster administrators should perform this action.

examples.summary: Delete a Let's Encrypt DNS plugin named 'cf-dns'

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named ACME plugin configuration from the cluster; any ACME accounts or certificate domains still referencing this plugin will fail to renew.
tips: Run get_cluster_acme_plugins_id first to confirm the plugin exists and note any accounts using it.
After deletion, verify no domain entries in any node's ACME config still reference the deleted plugin ID.
Returns null on success — no UPID is issued; the operation is synchronous.
